formula.tile_rule: full width while one padded row fits; else tile_cols = max_pixels/min_padded_rows; min_padded = 2*halo + 1
formula.read_amplification_model: (target_height + 2*halo*band_count)/target_height; conservative no-reuse upper bound; the section-17.2 lifetime contract (pin across X-tiles, reuse band-edge rows) is what permits approaching 1.0
formula.n_independence: frame_count is provenance only; tile_cols and device bytes are N-free; verified equal for 40 vs 600 frames

findings: full-width banding is feasible on a 5 GiB device budget down to ~2 GiB without X-tiling at production geometry; X-tile fallback verified (tile_cols follows max_pixels/min_padded)
reservoir (1536 B/ch/px) dominates the per-pixel cost: 4976 B OSC; it - not MoM groups - sets the band height

large multiband halos are the binding constraint: halo 62 needs band_core >= ~1260 rows for ra<=1.1, i.e. ~54 GiB device - infeasible; gate 9 must either keep band-edge rows resident via the reuse contract (then true application ra approaches 1.0 and this conservative bound must be revisited with a reuse-aware model) or fuse multiband differently
host pinning is slot-bounded (4+4 slots) not N-bounded: peak host pinned 62 MiB at 126-row bands, independent of frame_count
deferred: gate 6: workspace must allocate exactly these roles; telemetry must prove device_peak and host_pinned match the plan
gate 9: halo radius decision + reuse-aware RA model (the conservative bound overestimates when band-edge rows are reused)
gate 7: resume/index metadata sizes feed host_fixed_bytes
gate 8: local warp grids are an additional device/host role not yet in the table

post_decision_amendments.reason: the clip-accepted confidence contract needs sigma2 per kept reservoir candidate at fold time, and the device reservoir needs a hard slot bound because the hash-keep set is Binomial(N, R/N) and can exceed R
post_decision_amendments.changes: reservoir record 24 -> 32 B (adds sigma2); device slots = 2*R = 128 (overflow degrades a pixel to the uniform value, support kept); stream confidence drops B_c (reuses robust B) so S_c/C_c = 2 doubles; explicit coverage roles covB/covB2/contributors; +64 B/ch compact result record (AoS download)
post_decision_amendments.note: the results JSONL and measured_plans above reflect the pre-amendment 4976 B table; gate-6 telemetry re-verifies feasibility under the amended table

tests.coverage: role arithmetic, production plans, N-independence, host-slot bound, X-tile fallback, halo accounting, RA rejection, overflow and invalid inputs
